RadioUNet -- vendored third-party source
=========================================

source:   https://github.com/RonLevie/RadioUNet.git
commit:   36ab70663443af615c37051ce97da14d04925c7a
vendored: 2026-08-27
licence:  MIT, Copyright (c) 2019 Ron Levie (see LICENSE in this directory)

These files are unmodified upstream bytes, committed here rather than fetched at
build time so the baseline stays reproducible if the upstream repository moves.

Only lib/modules.py is taken. Upstream lib/loaders.py is a loader for the
RadioMapSeer dataset, which is not this dataset -- lunar_dataset.py replaces it,
and skipping it drops pandas, scikit-image and matplotlib from the dependency
list.

Line endings are LF, matching the upstream blobs. .gitattributes marks this
directory binary-ish (-text) so a Windows checkout does not rewrite them to CRLF
and break the checksums below.

Checksums (sha256):
  modules.py   60ee896f812710f6710cc0f3fc2f573844c0ebaabb4c331b452ed259bfd24235  (upstream lib/modules.py)
  LICENSE      32b73603c81d657744fc0ce578d0779b68c53a34cda0796bd579c94b300b8f83  (upstream LICENSE)

Verify:

    python radiounet.py --verify

Reference
---------
R. Levie, C. Yapar, G. Kutyniok, G. Caire, "RadioUNet: Fast Radio Map
Estimation with Convolutional Neural Networks", IEEE Transactions on Wireless
Communications, vol. 20, no. 6, pp. 4001-4015, 2021.
